purpose: 30 relevant product benchmarks requested by the owner; not a popularity ranking or purchase recommendation. Current capabilities are bounded evidence statements, not replacement claims.
delivery_rule: Build coherent native workflows and shared data contracts; use authorized integrations where a provider owns the network, registry, banking rail or licensed capability. No promise to fully reproduce all 30 products overnight.
mobile_rule: Every capability requires explicit web/iOS/Android acceptance; current native source checks do not establish physical-device or App Store delivery.
